title: Microsoft Stream: seek bar thumbnails for Teams meeting recordings
summary: Hold: the roadmap facts, general Stream licensing and recording controls check out, but several descriptions go beyond the published evidence. Microsoft has not documented the briefing's assurances that this feature leaves storage and access unchanged or takes no autonomous action.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe seek bar thumbnails, and its current feature list does not list them.

Read roadmap, current features and player settings; no default.

claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Stream seek bar thumbnails Teams meeting recordings default prerequisites licensing thumbnail generation storage'. Read Stream service description and its feature table, current video features and Clipchamp overview; no feature-specific entitlement.

claims.claim: The roadmap and Stream service description mention no meter for seek bar thumbnails.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Stream seek bar thumbnails Teams meeting recordings default prerequisites licensing thumbnail generation storage'. Read the complete roadmap description and Stream service description; neither names a meter for seek bar thumbnails.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents neither an admin UI nor an automation control for a tenant-wide seek bar thumbnail switch.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Stream Clipchamp seek bar hover thumbnails disable tenant site user setting Set-SPOTenant PowerShell Graph'. Read current features, player settings and searched Set-SPOTenant for thumbnail, seek, hover, Stream and Video; no matching switch.

claims.claim: No site or user setting for seek bar thumbnails is documented, and neither the current feature list nor Set-SPOTenant mentions one.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Stream Clipchamp seek bar hover thumbnails disable tenant site user setting Set-SPOTenant PowerShell Graph'. Read features-new-version-stream and player settings; searched Set-SPOTenant for thumbnail, seek, hover, Stream and Video. No seek bar thumbnail setting.

claims.claim: The recording toggle is reached in Teams admin center through Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording $true allows meeting recording for users assigned the policy.
claims.quote: To allow specific users in your organization to record, run the following commands: ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.where: controls[1].note; Scope: Prerequisites; Governance controls: notes
claims.claim: The Teams meeting policy controls whether assigned users can record meetings.
claims.quote: You can use the Microsoft Teams admin center or PowerShell to control whether your users can record meetings and events. ... -AllowCloudRecording controls whether users can record meetings; it doesn't configure or validate recording storage.

claims.claim: Private meeting recordings are uploaded to the meeting organiser's OneDrive.
claims.quote: It gets uploaded to the meeting organizer's OneDrive (private meetings) or SharePoint (channel meetings).

claims.claim: Channel meeting recordings are uploaded to SharePoint.
claims.quote: It gets uploaded to the meeting organizer's OneDrive (private meetings) or SharePoint (channel meetings).

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: OneDrive and SharePoint file storage and access permissions govern the recording files as other files.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview, OneDrive file storage, and access permissions apply to the meeting recording files the same as with other files.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described how seek bar thumbnail images are generated.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Stream seek bar thumbnails Teams meeting recordings default prerequisites licensing thumbnail generation storage'; '"seek bar thumbnails" Teams Stream permissions storage actions'. Read current features and Clipchamp overview; no generation mechanism.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described whether seek bar thumbnail images are stored separately from the recording.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Stream seek bar thumbnails Teams meeting recordings default prerequisites licensing thumbnail generation storage'; '"seek bar thumbnails" Teams Stream permissions storage actions'. Read current features and recording policies; no seek thumbnail storage description.

claims.claim: No prerequisites specific to seek bar thumbnails are published beyond the general Stream licensing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Stream seek bar thumbnails Teams meeting recordings default prerequisites licensing thumbnail generation storage'. Read Stream service description, current video features and player settings; no prerequisites specific to seek bar thumbnails.

claims.claim: The seek bar thumbnail feature changes nothing about where recordings are stored.
claims.quote: Searched: '"seek bar thumbnails" Teams Stream permissions storage actions'. Read roadmap, recording policies, Stream service description and Clipchamp overview. These state the existing recording locations but do not describe this feature's effect on storage.
claims.fix: Remove 'and it changes nothing about where recordings are stored or who can open them'. Retain the separately sourced sentence describing existing recording storage.

claims.claim: The seek bar thumbnail feature changes nothing about who can open recordings.
claims.quote: Searched: '"seek bar thumbnails" Teams Stream permissions storage actions'. Read roadmap, recording policies and Clipchamp overview. Existing file permissions are documented, but no passage describes this feature as leaving access unchanged.
claims.fix: Remove 'and it changes nothing about where recordings are stored or who can open them'. Retain the separately sourced statement that existing recording files follow OneDrive file storage and access permissions.

claims.claim: The feature takes no action on its own.
claims.quote: Searched: '"seek bar thumbnails" Teams Stream permissions storage actions'. Read roadmap, current video features and Clipchamp overview. The roadmap describes hover previews, but no source states that the feature takes no action on its own.
claims.fix: Replace 'No change: the feature displays previews and takes no action on its own' with 'The roadmap describes previews displayed when someone hovers over the seek bar; it mentions no autonomous actions.'

claims.claim: Turning off Meeting recording prevents assigned users from recording meetings rather than controlling seek bar thumbnails.
claims.quote: To allow or prevent meeting recordings, follow these steps: ... Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off. ... -AllowCloudRecording controls whether users can record meetings; it doesn't configure or validate recording storage.

claims.claim: Blocking channel recording download saves channel meeting recordings to a View only folder.
claims.quote: Block - Channel meeting recordings and transcripts are saved to a Recordings\View only folder in the channel's SharePoint site.

claims.claim: Stream's seek bar is the timeline along the bottom of the player.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Clipchamp Stream video player seek timeline hover preview thumbnails on by default'. Read the roadmap, current features and Clipchamp player overview; no passage locates the seek bar along the bottom.
claims.fix: Remove the parenthetical '(the timeline along the bottom)'.

controlChecks.governs: Whether users can record meetings, and so whether there are recordings for thumbnails to appear on
